name: smart-pantry-manager
description: Smart Pantry Manager — Smart Food Inventory & Waste Reduction System

scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
